inventory: No full P/U1 cache found in current Maxwell role outputs or W5 Maxwell core-cache. Core contains seven global/story tables only; reusable Link inputs cover six K2/K5 records, not 192.
excluded: K12/Story7 singleton RH4X excluded by prespecified common-six-case complete-device subset, not by response values. All other non-common-complete devices excluded equally.
read_policy: Only Element Forces - Links P and Element Deformations - Links U1 once each; target-filter only; no extraction of seven global tables. Stop on incomplete groups, no filling. Hash original once before and compare before/after stat.
units: P kN, U1 mm divided by1000 to m, t seconds. P-I/J pointwise identical, count I once. Preserve all source rows in local paired NPZ, P cell column I, U1 cell column H.
rank_policy: Within each Case/Story eight devices only, rank max abs native P and conditional Dport separately; top2 by second ordered value and bottom2 by seventh ordered descending value, include exact boundary ties. Report native W alongside conditional Dport; no tuned thresholds.
no_claims: No physical property certification, independent validation, geometry/global direction inference, event independence from X/Y, full88 energy closure, causal reduction, optimal placement or good/bad label.
local_history_policy: Complete paired NPZ local only, not upload or default Git whitelist. Main handoff 192 summary rows plus ranks and small metadata.
partial_policy: Keep actual completed range if bounded timeout/failure; no extended reruns.
